coveredInvariants: The platform SDK obtains server workload tokens. Evelyn signed project, team and Preview checks and the observed crm-preview audit establish source identity.
Deployment protection and application authorization are distinct. Owner cookies and invalid service credentials cannot authenticate service verification.
The client is server-only. Secrets and tokens are neither returned to the browser nor persisted in the final sanitized evidence.
Exact Preview project/runtime gates, QA tenant equal to workspace, registered project allowlist and positive project write grant are enforced.
Create uses the complete 2,037,000-cent obligation and a trusted accepted, approved CRM offer with acceptance audit.
Verify carries exactly eight fields. Nonce and JTI bind the route and canonical payload; only a strictly validated VALID response permits fresh execution.
The separate Owner session issues distinct Step 1 and Step 2 challenges with reauthentication. CRM exposes no Owner decision API.
Immutable version/hash revisions and source/action CAS after the remote call prevent an old reference from executing a changed action.
Each offer has one action lineage. Durable idempotency binds the payload; retries produce one execution, and the changed action has zero effects.
Pending, unknown and missing references, scope overrides and invalid service identities fail closed live. Fault, timing and Production identity negatives remain local tests.
Cross-system action/correlation and CRM command, receipt, audit and domain-event chains resolve to the persisted actor and project scope.
Flow A accepted/rejected statuses, company lifecycle, manual delivery and stopped follow-ups, plus Flow B sold inventory, agree with the read-only database results.
The actual Preview MFA session is Secure and HttpOnly. Localhost transport and existing authorization policy boundaries remain intact.
Production targets, protection and OIDC remain unchanged. Only exact Preview trust and ten branch Preview environment keys were configured.

limitations: This review concerns explicitly synthetic Preview behavior and bounded integration/Sales paths. It is not a Production go-live approval.
No actual Production tokens or endpoints, business delivery or payment were tested. Production identity rejection is supported by local RS256/JWKS policy evidence.
Timeout, unreachable service, HTTP faults, malformed responses and concurrency failures are covered by local tests; they were not injected into the live Preview.
The final infrastructure check compares metadata, protection, trust and target IDs. It does not decrypt secret values.
The first Preview cookie failure at 461f42 and the source ACL/native timeout preparation failures remain preserved. Final PASS applies only to 137c796 and the final artifacts.
